content:
I recently submitted PR #43069, which adds second-derivative sign lemmas at local extrema. My longer-term goal is to formalize the maximum principle for elliptic PDEs, and my next step is to work on the Hessian and Laplacian at a local maximum.

Is anyone already working on something similar? I would also appreciate any suggestions on the API design and where these results should live in mathlib.
Note that so long as CI is failing, nobody will look at it
The failure didn't look like an issue with the mathematics so I just reran CI hoping it will pass.
